survey_most_confusing_text:
Firstly, the most confusing thing were than almost every command position change so I needed to search in all the interface for the button I wanted to select. The fact than icon's logos + commands didn't changed between the session 1 & 2 helped a lot. If you were adding or removing commands (for instance, a new brush mode), I would have been super-confused.

Secondly, I was confused by my muscle memory because each time you ask for a command selection, I automatically started to put my mouse in the direction where it was in the session 1 layout. This have been easier during tutorial 2 & 3. Now, if you reswitch to the previous layout, I'll be confused for the same reason.

Last thing, the global layout was the same, so this help to guess where a command is. For example, the rectangle command was close to the elipsis command. So, I was able to guess where is the rectangle command is cause I known where the new position of the elipsis was.

The "paint" commands on the bottom of the application. Almost never see this in an edit software.
Same thing for the calcs layer widget, it's usualy on the right or in a floating window.
